title: sim01_04_simulation_mode_test TC-SIM-01-01 (missing instance_projections relation) and obs03_audit_log_test TC-OBS-03-INT-02/05 (500 errors on GET /audit): PgError.ServerError cluster needing per-file root-causing
symptom: GH-652's own recommended split grouped sim01 and obs03 together as part of a 'PgError.ServerError cluster needing verbose logging' (alongside svc04 and xc06, both now resolved in this pass -- svc04 confirmed already-passing-in-isolation, false positive; xc06 fixed 8/9, residual tracked separately in ISS-0653). Re-measured in true isolation with `-Dlog-pg-errors=true`: (1) sim01_04_simulation_mode_test.zig TC-SIM-01-01 ('simulation events are isolated from real tenant queries') fails with PostgreSQL C42P01 'relation "instance_projections" does not exist', raised from src/event_store/store.zig's append() via src/simulation/tenant_store.zig's appendSimulationEvent()/mapStoreError() -- the simulation-mode event store path is querying an unqualified/wrongly-scoped `instance_projections` table that isn't resolvable from whatever schema context the simulation harness sets up; not yet root-caused further. Note: the SAME narrow build step (test-integration-stage11-sim-xc04) also surfaced an unrelated failure in xc04_kernel_determinism_test.zig TC-XC-04-04 (function signature mismatch on bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash) -- that is NOT part of GH-652's original 20-file list and has been filed separately as ISS-0655 per the incidental-discovery protocol. (2) obs03_audit_log_test.zig TC-OBS-03-INT-02 ('read-only GET/list operations do not create audit rows') and TC-OBS-03-INT-05 ('GET /audit supports filters with deterministic pagination and ordering') both fail with expected 200, found 500 -- a genuine server-side error on the GET /audit endpoint path, not yet root-caused (the real exception/error body was not captured in this pass).
acceptance_criteria: sim01: root-cause why instance_projections is unresolvable in the simulation-mode event-append path -- check whether src/simulation/tenant_store.zig sets tenant_context/search_path correctly before calling event_store.store.append(), and whether this is a schema-qualification gap similar to the ones fixed elsewhere in this same GH-652 pass (onboarding.zig, tasks/store.zig)

obs03: capture the actual 500 response body / server-side exception for TC-OBS-03-INT-02 and TC-OBS-03-INT-05 (add temporary error logging if the handler swallows the real cause) and root-cause from there
Both files pass in isolation (zig build test-integration-stage11-sim-xc04 for sim01's TC-SIM-01-01 specifically; a narrow test-integration-obs03 step already exists), twice consecutively
zig build test exits 0 with unit-test pass count >= established baseline (1011/1075, 64 skipped)
next_action: File as GitHub issue and add to global queue. Both files need their real underlying error captured before a fix can be attempted -- sim01's error is already captured (missing relation) and ready for root-causing; obs03's 500 needs one more diagnostic pass (server-side error logging) before its fix is even scoped.
resolution:
Both root-caused and fixed independently -- unrelated root causes despite the shared filing.

sim01_04_simulation_mode_test.zig TC-SIM-01-01: the simulation tenant ID (from deriveSimulationTenantId) and the test's freshly-generated real_tenant_str are both genuine, distinct per-run tenant identities that route through the same schema-per-tenant machinery as any real tenant (store.append() issues `SET LOCAL search_path TO tenant_<id>,public` for whichever tenant_id it receives) -- but the test never provisioned either physical schema, so instance_projections (and every other per-tenant table) genuinely did not exist there (C42P01), exactly as the sim path's stack trace showed. Fixed by calling the existing, idempotent provisionTenantSchema() for both tenant IDs (matching the established pattern already used in env03_test.zig and others), then discovered two more instances of the same underlying gap once the schema itself existed: (1) insertProjection()'s INSERT and registry.registerType() calls are unqualified, so they need the threadlocal tenant context (bpm.api_tenant_context) explicitly switched to each tenant before writing that tenant's rows -- event_type_registry turned out to be per-tenant-schema too, requiring the event type to be registered in both schemas, not once; (2) queryTenantEvents()'s underlying readGlobal() also has no explicit search_path of its own and depends entirely on the threadlocal being set correctly at call time. Also fixed the cleanup helpers (cleanupSim01IsolationFixtures, a new cleanupEventTypeFixtureForTenants) to clean both tenants' schemas under their own context, since the sim tenant ID is deterministic (same seed every run) and would otherwise accumulate orphaned rows in its schema across every future run. Verified: zig build test-integration-stage11-sim-xc04 -- 14/14 pass (was 12/14 before this pass plus GH-664's xc04 fix), re-run twice.

obs03_audit_log_test.zig TC-OBS-03-INT-02/05: re-ran with -Dlog-pg-errors=true and captured the real error for the first time -- C42883 'operator does not exist: text = uuid' from src/obs/audit.zig's handleList() query builder. audit_entries.resource_id was converted from UUID to TEXT by migrations/1107 and GBL-120 (same class of change already fixed in 4 other places this session: adp09, tasks/store.zig, xc04's chain-hash test, and this same audit_entries column elsewhere), but this GET /audit filter's `resource_id = $N::uuid` cast was never updated -- a genuine production bug breaking the resource_id filter on the real API endpoint for any live caller, not just this test. Fixed by removing the incorrect cast (actor_id and pipeline_run_id's ::uuid casts in the same function are correct and were left untouched -- those columns are genuinely UUID). Verified: zig build test-integration-obs03 -- 6/6 pass (was 4/6), re-run twice.
